parsed.why: Long-decriminalised, statutory anti-discrimination incl. gender identity (2022), courts grant marker changes; daily discrimination and some violence documented but no visitor-facing restriction or targeting. Reduced risk.

Cross-dressing criminalised, sodomy to life imprisonment, no recognition, documented extrajudicial killings, torture, vigilante violence, religious-authority control, conflict. Structural signals resolve to severe risk.

Decriminalised; incitement ban and homicide aggravator explicitly cover gender identity; attitudes broadly neutral, violence not targeted. No LGR and repealed employment protection are resident gaps; no documented visitor exposure.

Active state hostility: street profiling/detention of trans women, 313 documented violations, prison isolation and custody death, 'family' criminalisation drafts, worsening trajectory. Detention machinery is an enforced exposure, not recourse.

Decriminalised with GI-inclusive anti-discrimination and hate-crime law, but documented organised violence at assemblies, hostile surveys (84% anti-marriage), worsening trend, unreliable clinical settings. Elevated risk.
